Game Overview

In Village Attack!, the core idea is straightforward: lead your army to victory by conquering enemy villages. Master unique skills, devise clever strategies, and expand your reign. With every win, your power increases, turning your forces into an unstoppable empire. Will you rise as a legendary conqueror?

How to Play

Getting started in Village Attack! doesn't take long to learn. Lead your army to victory by conquering enemy villages! Master unique skills, devise clever strategies, and expand your reign. With every win, your power increases, turning your forces into an unstoppable empire. Will you rise as a legendary conqueror?

Related FAQs

The goal is to lead your army to victory by conquering enemy villages. Master unique skills, devise clever strategies, and expand your reign.
